# Project instructions

For Angular 21+ feature modules, read and follow `.agents/skills/angular-module-scaffold/SKILL.md` before changing code. Implement only operations already defined by approved OpenAPI contracts. Keep a `doc.md` in the root of each feature module and consult `.spec/memory/produto.md` and `.spec/memory/contexto-tecnico.md` before implementation.

For a new Angular frontend, read and follow `.agents/skills/angular-frontend-scaffold/SKILL.md`. If the project name is absent, ask for it before any change. Use the deterministic generator and validate only with the build; do not create tests or start a frontend server or API.

For Angular UI work, read and follow `.agents/skills/angular-tailwind-ui-specialist/SKILL.md`. Use Tailwind CSS, semantic HTML, mobile-first responsiveness, accessibility, and Neon Graphite tokens. Do not place business rules or HTTP behavior in templates.

For Java persistence work involving JPA/Hibernate, SQL performance, transactions, concurrency, PostgreSQL, or Flyway, read and follow `.agents/skills/java-persistence-performance/SKILL.md` and only the references relevant to the task.
